appearance_facts.fact: Five vertical bars are shown in order: Utility solar (yellow), Offshore wind (light blue), Hydro storage (blue), Bioenergy (green), Geothermal heat (brown).
The yellow bar is the leftmost; its top edge is just above the 40 gridline, with the label 41.2% centered above it.
The light blue bar is the second from left and is the tallest bar in the chart; its top edge is just below the 70 gridline, with the label 29.8% centered above it.
The blue bar is the third from left; its top edge is between the 50 and 55 gridlines, with the label 18.5% centered above it.
The green bar is the fourth from left and is the shortest bar in the chart; its top edge is just above the 20 gridline, with the label 7.2% centered above it.
The brown bar is the rightmost; its top edge is just above the 35 gridline, with the label 3.3% centered above it.

printed_facts.fact: Title reads: Clean Grid Contribution by Resource.
Y-axis label reads: Reported clean-grid share (%). Tick values are 0, 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35, 40, 45, 50, 55, 60, 65, 70.
X-axis category labels, left to right: Utility solar, Offshore wind, Hydro storage, Bioenergy, Geothermal heat.

public_definitions: Routing criterion: Largest clean-generation contribution source.

User goal: identify the clean-generation source with the largest contribution, then send that source into priority contribution review; leave any source not meeting the routing threshold out of the priority queue.
uncertain: The printed percentage labels do not match the bar heights on the y-axis scale (e.g., the tallest bar, Offshore wind, is labeled 29.8% while the shorter Utility solar bar is labeled 41.2%); it is unclear whether the labels or the bar geometry should be treated as the authoritative values for determining the largest contribution.
